description: Get detailed information about a specific init script. Secrets in the script content (access/secret keys, passwords, tokens) are REDACTED by default and the response carries secretsRedacted=true; pass includeSecrets=true only if you genuinely need the raw values.

includeSecrets.description: Return initScriptContent unredacted (default false). Even when true, the response still reports how many secret-like values were detected.

name: ncloud_get_init_script_detail
